stages.reason: Validated CLI latency and error-reporting gaps from user incident logs.
stages.revisit_trigger: Material shift in target user personas or CLI command scope
stages.acceptance_criteria: Problem brief ratified with baseline p95 latency and exit-code error metrics.

stages.reason: Evaluated parser and schema validation library tradeoffs.
stages.revisit_trigger: New schema draft or runtime dependency constraint
stages.acceptance_criteria: At least two alternatives compared with failure modes and footprint bounds.

stages.reason: Committed scope, owners, and rollback boundaries for v1.8 release.
stages.revisit_trigger: Scope expansion beyond local CLI validation
stages.acceptance_criteria: Named owners assigned for all required controls and release gates.

stages.reason: Public CLI flags, exit classes, and JSON schema contracts specified.
stages.revisit_trigger: Addition of new CLI subcommands or schema fields
stages.acceptance_criteria: All CLI exit codes and schema invariants mapped to testable requirements.

stages.reason: Core validator isolated from optional knowledge selector.
stages.revisit_trigger: New extension port or external adapter introduction
stages.acceptance_criteria: Zero dependency edges from CORE to EXTENSION verified in component registry.

stages.reason: Implementation of profile-aware validator checks in progress.
stages.acceptance_criteria: All unit and negative fixture checks pass without untracked bytecode.

stages.reason: Negative test suite and cross-platform checkout verification required before release.
stages.acceptance_criteria: Linux and Windows CI jobs pass 100% of positive and negative fixtures.

stages.reason: Package manifest must be sealed and verified on clean checkout.
stages.acceptance_criteria: Fresh gate pass on exact candidate digest before promotion.

stages.reason: CLI runs offline in user workspaces; operational telemetry is adapted to CI run logs and issue reports.
stages.revisit_trigger: Introduction of hosted service or background daemon
stages.acceptance_criteria: Post-release CI failure rate and user issue triage tracked per release tag.

stages.reason: Post-release outcome observations feed back into requirement and test updates.
stages.revisit_trigger: Post-release review window (14 days after tag)
stages.acceptance_criteria: Every accepted feedback item links source observation to regression test and outcome.

stages.reason: Schema v1.7 to v1.8 migration requires explicit version bump and changelog record.
stages.revisit_trigger: Breaking change to schema enums or manifest structure
stages.acceptance_criteria: Standard evolution record ratified with migration path and negative tests.

stages.reason: Active v1.8 package; no component or service withdrawal is scheduled in this cycle.
stages.revisit_trigger: Decision to deprecate v1.x line or withdraw a public command

concerns.reason: Measurable reduction in duplicate governance files and false-positive validation claims.
concerns.acceptance_criteria: Single manifest inventory and zero unvalidated schemas verified.

concerns.reason: CLI help and deterministic error messages are primary human interfaces.
concerns.revisit_trigger: CLI flag or output format changes
concerns.acceptance_criteria: Read-only --help and clear exit-code diagnostics verified.

concerns.reason: Validator path traversal, symlink escape, and evidence overwrite risks must be blocked.
concerns.revisit_trigger: Any change to file I/O or path resolution in tools/
concerns.acceptance_criteria: Path traversal and canonical overwrite attempts rejected in negative suite.

concerns.reason: Validator depends only on Python stdlib and pinned jsonschema.
concerns.revisit_trigger: Addition of any third-party package in requirements-validation.txt
concerns.acceptance_criteria: Dependency list bounded to jsonschema>=4.18 with offline schema resolution.

concerns.reason: Package contains only public specification prose, schemas, and synthetic fixtures; no personal data is collected or stored.
concerns.revisit_trigger: Addition of telemetry collection or user-submitted data storage

concerns.reason: Every normative rule in schemas and validator requires positive and negative test coverage.
concerns.revisit_trigger: New schema constraint or validator check
concerns.acceptance_criteria: All negative fixtures fail as expected and positive fixtures pass.

concerns.reason: Distributed repository requires LF normalization and SHA256 manifest integrity check.
concerns.revisit_trigger: Release packaging or CI workflow changes
concerns.acceptance_criteria: MANIFEST.json hashes and byte sizes match clean checkouts on Linux and Windows.

concerns.reason: Static reference package has no stateful runtime service; reliability applies to deterministic validator execution.
concerns.revisit_trigger: Addition of network calls or long-running daemon tools
concerns.acceptance_criteria: Validator executes deterministically offline with zero side effects outside .validation/.

concerns.reason: Lightweight static validation runs in under 5 seconds on standard CI runners with no paid cloud infrastructure.
concerns.revisit_trigger: CI runtime exceeding 2 minutes or introduction of paid external services

concerns.reason: All 15 controls and 37 invariants map to normative files and explicit verification obligations.
concerns.revisit_trigger: Standard version bump or control boundary modification
concerns.acceptance_criteria: Control and invariant coverage ledgers pass 100% of cross-checks.
